verdict.rationale: The SDK docs say Vanta's SDKs are generated from an OpenAPI specification, which shows a spec exists internally. Nothing documents that users can download it, and the probe found every common OpenAPI path returning 404. The llms.txt and markdown doc pages are machine-readable documentation, not an API spec, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
